name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-07-10, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
